name: dev_explain_error
description: Developer pack: explains an error or traceback and how to fix it. Use for 'explain this error', 'why is this failing', 'what does this traceback mean' (from the clipboard, the selection or pasted text).
instructions: 1. Get the error text: what the user pasted or selected, otherwise read_clipboard. 2. Call analyze_error with error_text (and path = their project folder if they named one). 3. If the error names a function, class or file in their project, code_search that project for it (limit 5) and read_file the most relevant hit around the failing line. 4. Reply in plain words: what went wrong, the most likely cause, and the fix as 1-3 concrete steps. Do not edit any file. If they ask you to fix it, hand it over with dev_handoff instead.
